steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: We're almost there.
You carefully avoid the gangsters in the mayhem, but you can't actually get out of the battlefield.
The rotten odor of burnt proteins, the frenetic gunfire and screams, and the bitterness in your mouth—All of these irritate you.
SALVA is getting closer. The closer you get, the more tragic the situation is.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: The news of SALVA hiding felony Sinners has spread throughout the city. It's the last straw the gangs can stand, who have decided to teach these jerks a lesson.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But now they're killing each other.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: That's because Mania has destroyed their sanity. SALVA knows how to take advantage of Mania more than the girl who attacked you.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Those devils didn't start the hospital to "save lives".
Ted doesn't reply and suddenly stops you and signals you to keep quiet.
On the other side of the street, several men in white robes are carrying a stretcher and doing something to the gangsters on the ground.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...It's SALVA. Be careful not to get caught.
Most of the members of SALVA have mechanical prostheses and wear white robes with a broken and upside-down cross. An ambulance full of bullet holes is parked nearby.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: SALVA is saving the gangsters?! They're too far away to hear what they're saying... Ah! They're fighting each other.
It is just a one-sided fight. A doctor-looking man slaps the injured gangster heavily, who then passes out and is put on a stretcher.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: That is my subordinate. I sent him to spy on SALVA. I don't know how much more torture he will suffer if he gets taken away.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Wait! I've seen him before.
He looks at the leader of the SALVA doctors.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I remember him. He was the one who took in the target Sinner who escaped to SALVA.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You mean we can get intel from him?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: As long as you guys can control that guy.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Come on, Chief. Fight with your Sinners.
